units.source_text: 中将回京之后，想特地写信给这女子，但又觉得唐突。

en.t: After the captain returned to the capital, he wanted to write specially to the woman, but felt it would be too abrupt.

units.source_text: 那时隐约的一瞥，一直不能忘怀。

en.t: He could not forget the brief, indistinct glimpse he had caught of her then.

units.source_text: 此女所忧虑的是何事，虽然不得而知，但总觉得非常可怜。

en.t: Though he did not know what was troubling her, he felt she was deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 于是在八月十日过后，入山狩猎小鸟时，乘便又来访问小野草庵。

en.t: So after the tenth day of the eighth month, when he went into the hills to hunt small birds, he took the opportunity to visit the thatched hut at Ono again.

units.source_text: 照例呼唤小尼僧少将君出来，叫她传言：“自从那天瞥见芳姿之后，至今心绪不得安宁……”

en.t: As usual, he called out the young nun Shojo no Kimi and had her convey his message: “Ever since I glimpsed your lovely figure that day, my heart has had no peace...”

units.source_text: 妹尼僧知道浮舟是不肯应对的，便代答道：“看来这孩子好似待乳山上的女郎花，另有意中人吧。”

en.t: The younger nun, knowing that Ukifune would not answer, replied on her behalf, “It seems this child is like the maidenflower on Mount Matsuchi, with someone else in her heart.”

units.source_text: 中将和妹尼僧会面之后，告道：“前日闻知这位小姐有伤心之事，不知其人身世如何，颇思详悉一二。

en.t: After meeting with the younger nun, the captain said, “The other day I heard that this young lady has suffered some sorrow. Since I do not know her circumstances, I should very much like to learn a little more.

units.source_text: 我也常恨万事不能称心，有心入山遁世，只因父母不许，以致身受阻碍，因循度日至今。

en.t: I too have often lamented that nothing goes as I wish, and have long wanted to enter the mountains and renounce the world, but because my parents would not allow it, I have been held back and have let the days pass until now.

units.source_text: 恐是自己心情郁结之故，觉得乐天享福之人，性情与我不合。

en.t: Perhaps because my own heart is so oppressed, I feel no kinship with people who live cheerfully and enjoy good fortune.

units.source_text: 却想找个伤心饮恨之人，向她诉说衷情呢。”

en.t: Instead, I wish to find someone burdened with grief and resentment, and confide my true feelings to her.”

units.source_text: 这话表示对浮舟恋慕之心甚切。

en.t: These words showed how deeply he longed for Ukifune.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧答道：“你要寻找伤心饮恨之人，此女确甚适当。

en.t: The younger nun replied, “If you are seeking someone burdened with grief and resentment, this woman is certainly most suitable.

units.source_text: 然而其人厌世之心异常深切，不愿像普通女子一般婚嫁，而只想出家为尼……

en.t: Yet her weariness of the world is unusually profound. She does not wish to marry like an ordinary woman, but only wants to take vows and become a nun...

units.source_text: 即使是余龄已少的老人，到了即将落发被缁之时，亦不免凄然伤怀。

en.t: Even an old person with little life remaining cannot help feeling desolate and sorrowful when the time comes to cut off the hair and put on black robes.

units.source_text: 何况妙龄少女，出家之后结局如何，实在很可担心。”

en.t: How much more, then, for a young girl in the bloom of life; what will become of her after she takes vows is truly worrying.”

units.source_text: 这是做母亲者的口气。

en.t: This was the tone of a mother speaking.

units.source_text: 她就走进内室，对浮舟说道：“这样太无情了。

en.t: She then went into the inner room and said to Ukifune, “This is far too coldhearted.

units.source_text: 你总得略微应酬一下才好。

en.t: You ought at least to respond to him a little.

units.source_text: 幽居寂处的人，对些些小事寄予情趣，也是世之常事。”

en.t: For people living in lonely seclusion, it is only natural to find feeling and interest in small things.”

units.source_text: 她虽然多方劝说，但浮舟非常冷淡地答道：“我连对人说话的方法也不懂得，完全是个不中用的人了。”

en.t: Though she urged her in many ways, Ukifune answered very coldly, “I do not even know how to speak to people. I have become completely useless.”

units.source_text: 说罢就躺卧下来。

en.t: With that, she lay down.

units.source_text: 外边客人说道：“怎么没有回音？

en.t: The guest outside said, “Why is there no reply?

units.source_text: 太无情了！

en.t: How heartless!

units.source_text: ‘约会在秋天’这话定然是骗我。”

en.t: Those words, ‘Let us meet in autumn,’ must surely have been meant to deceive me.”

units.source_text: 他不胜苦恨，遂吟诗曰：

en.t: Unable to bear his anguish and resentment, he then composed a poem:
